lastCompletedStory.title: Make the CONTEXT.md plannable-issue and plannable-set entries agree with the shipped predicate

nextStoryContext: CONTEXT.md's three related glossary entries now agree with the shipped isPlannable predicate (src/issues/plannable.ts:20-26). The 'plannable issue' entry (line 72) was reworded to name acceptance criteria as one of the qualifying conditions and dropped the false absolute sentence ('This is the single condition that qualifies an issue for /cam-plan'). The 'plannable set' entry (line 248) was reworded the same way. The 'plannable gate' entry (line 431) was already correct and untouched, serving as the wording pin. Fix was glossary-only prose (no implementation detail, no code citation, per the Domain Model Convention), unlike the command-doc twins fixed in US-002 which DO cite plannable.ts:20-26. The still-open, explicitly out-of-scope item noted in this story's prd.json notes is the missing 'push-recovered' glossary entry (an omission, not a contradiction) -- not addressed here, left for a future story if ever prioritized.
